description: Temporary endpoint containment. Blocks POST requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /CMSPages/Staging/SyncServer.asmx.
affected_versions: Kentico Xperience: 0 through 13.0.178; Kentico Xperience: 0 through 13.0.172; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Blocks POST requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /CMSPages/Staging/SyncServer.asmx.
limitations: The body or authentication mechanism is not inspected; disabling this delivery endpoint is not exploit detection. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Blocks legitimate uses of this operation too. This is a temporary containment option for policies that can disable the operation; review application compatibility before enabling.
